'Samahan niyo kaming seniors kontra kurakot sa February 25'

Naglakad sa mga mall malapit sa Chinatown  ngayong araw, February 22, ang Seniors Kontra Kurakot para sa kanilang first Lunar year 'mall walk'.

Nagimbita silang sumama sa malaking rally kontra korapsyon sa February 25, ika-40 taon ng EDSA people power sa EDSA shrine.

LOOK: Members of Seniors Kontra Kurakot hold an Anti-Corruption Mall Walk at Tutuban Center Mall near Chinatown in Manila on Sunday, Feb. 22. 

The group marches toward Dragon 8 Mall and 168 Shopping Mall as part of activities leading to the 40th anniversary of the EDSA People Power Revolution and calls on the public to join the Feb. 25 protest at the EDSA Shrine in Quezon City. 

📸: John Louie Abrina/MB
